item.title: Version 1.3.24
item.description: The Getting Started window is now a floating window you can drag to the side and keep open while you set up (30% bigger, seven steps; Help > Getting Started opens it again). Track presets can have any names: the app matches the delivered instrument names to your preset names, including names written run together (TrumpetSolo) and plurals (TRUMPETS). Pro Tools templates and track presets can be in any folder, Use open session works in the session already open in Pro Tools, and new installs start with no Session Setup Presets.
